title: Achieve advertised 30 FPS
description: Dirty-pixel workaround (CompositorPacer) already implemented in MirrorEngine.swift lines 593-652. 1x1 window toggles between black and near-black at 30Hz via CADisplayLink. close_reason: Fixed: pacer window now targets virtual display NSScreen instead of NSScreen.main; 4x4 dirty region; timer fallback for mirror-mode displays without own NSScreen

title: Debug blank screen on DC-1 after setup
description: GitHub issue #11: After granting permissions and clicking Start Mirror, DC-1 stays blank while Mac shows 'Waiting for client'. May be connectivity issue or missing instructions for DC-1 side steps.
close_reason: Fixed: ADB reverse tunnel race condition -- tunnel was set up before TCP server started. Reordered startup, added tunnel result checking, moved client tracking to connection .ready state, added diagnostic logging in native code.

title: Fix connection state flickering during reconnect
description: GitHub issue #13: Status overlay on Android app flickers between connected/disconnected during reconnection. 500ms debounce insufficient. Increase debounce window or suppress overlay during initial connection attempts.
close_reason: Fixed: increased debounce from 500ms to 2s, added 3-tier state machine (silent/reconnecting/full-waiting) in MirrorActivity.onConnectionState(). Build untested (no JDK on machine).
